::: {#bio}

Hello! I am Aiden Hewitt. I am a recent graduate from [Lawrence University](https://www.lawrence.edu/), [Appleton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appleton,_Wisconsin), Wisconsin. I graduated with a major in Biology & Neuroscience with a minor in data science. This website is to highlight some of my projects in data science.

Outside of data science I enjoy biotechnology and am pursuing a masters in Biotechnology from the University of Auckland, Auckland, New Zealand.
